listing.name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind (OpenMW)
listing.summary: Set up The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind through its upstream openmw player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use this original game and edition
steps.instruction: Use your own installed Morrowind Data Files and Morrowind.ini through the OpenMW installation wizard. Tribunal and Bloodmoon need their own corresponding installed data and deliberate load order. Console originals and saves are not interchangeable PC inputs. Keep your originals elsewhere unchanged; upstream handles its own data recognition and preparation. A Portcove registration does not authenticate original-game files.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the real player
steps.instruction: The official Windows EXE is an installer, not the game to register. Complete upstream setup, run the OpenMW wizard/launcher deliberately to locate Morrowind.ini and Data Files, and choose the desired content/mod order. Then register the installed openmw.exe with its installation folder as working directory. Keep openmw-launcher.exe for setup and mod/profile choices; discovery does not run that wizard automatically.

steps.title: Keep the actual original and player data
steps.instruction: Windows normally keeps OpenMW configuration, logs, saves and screenshots under the actual Documents/My Games/OpenMW folder. Custom configuration/user-data paths and external mod/data directories remain part of your setup. Preserve those actual locations, selected originals and load order with the player closed before upstream updates. OpenMW saves and original-engine saves are separate formats; keep their creating runtime rather than assuming conversion.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream setup first. Registration saves your selected executable, working directory and literal arguments; Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this external runtime, original files and profile. Registration-only removal preserves them. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are not offered for these external files. Preserve a working copy and its data before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own supported upstream application/native flow.
